readiness_rule: Keep all registered physical channels; exclude a dataset if any channel has no observed A_fit or A_stop target support, if time/schema/prefix validation fails, or if no complete role window exists. No forecast scores used.
batch_rule: Admit ready candidates in the registered order until at least three datasets. Seal exact admitted jobs and data bindings before training. Preserve excluded diagnostics.
known_preparation_risk: AirQuality NMHC may have no A_stop observations. Do not drop that column using V information; retain a NOT_READY diagnosis and proceed to the registered fallback.
dataset_dependence: ETTh1 and ETTh2 are separate transformer stations in the same benchmark family; Appliances is a separate building-sensor dataset.
future_queue: Exchange if an admissible source is obtained
future_queue_rule: Register concrete source metadata, preprocessing, channels and dataset order before any future batch's new numeric preparation or forecast scores. Continue if no positive example is verified.
